description.en:
MagicBot X1 is MagicLab's humanoid platform emphasizing dynamic whole-body movement and application development. Its updated joint modules and enlarged motion ranges are intended to support more demanding poses and coordinated actions. The structure combines lightweight metals and polymer materials to balance rigidity, weight and durability.

A dual-battery, hot-swappable power system allows batteries to be replaced without shutting the robot down, subject to the operating procedure and available charged packs. MagicLab also presents an open development ecosystem for building additional behaviors. Motion demonstrations and peak joint-torque figures describe particular capabilities; sustained task performance depends on the software, workload and operating environment.

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: Standard and education configurations both list 70 kg.
